laws.rule: Since 13 January 2026 Miyagi Prefecture charges an accommodation tax of JPY 300 a person a night (about A$2.71, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku. No tax under a room-only rate of JPY 6,000 (about A$54.14). In Sendai the JPY 300 is split JPY 100 prefecture and JPY 200 city.
